message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; duplicate names and obvious naming variations were consolidated. The primary product sources were not used or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-11 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-12 07:40 UTC** (**2026-10-11 13:10 IST through 2026-10-12 13:10 IST**).

No confirmed new vulnerability was found that both falls within the strict 24-hour window and maps to a component or version in the DLL inventory. Fresh public records reviewed during the window affected unrelated products; similarly named WordPress plugins and generic AJAX references were rejected as false matches.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official MongoDB libraries and integrations.

No MongoDB-family vulnerability could be verified as newly reported or authoritatively updated in the scan window. MongoDB's latest authoritative alerts visible during the run were dated October 9 or earlier and were therefore excluded. Source: [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported, in-scope vulnerabilities during this window. Continue normal monitoring. This result does not reassess older known vulnerabilities already associated with the inventory's legacy component versions.
